title: Exposed Man With Gun In Hand
original_title: Hombre Expuesto Con Arma En Mano
overview: Hombre Expuesto Con Arma En Mano presents a vision of aggression amidst a bleak environment. A nameless man desperately wields a gun wherever he goes; his interactions with those around him are infused with rage and violence. Try as he might to escape his burden, his is a futile exercise as he comes the realization there is no evading his inner nature, the world around him is as much a burden upon him as it is his foe.
